Build a 20-second, 16:9 (1920x1080) viral product-launch film for AIAccountant.com — India's first AI accountant — in the style of the hyper-polished launch videos that go viral on X (think Linear / Arc / Raycast launch films): pure black canvas, massive kinetic typography slammed on the beat, aggressive expo-out easing, hard cuts, 3D-tilted glass UI, motion-blur smears, light blooms, subtle film grain + vignette. Music only, NO voiceover: a punchy ~128 BPM electronic track with a sub-bass hit at 0s, a riser into a big drop at exactly 4.0s, and whooshes/impacts on every cut. Every beat must also read perfectly muted.

DESIGN SYSTEM
- Background #000000. Type white #FFFFFF, secondary #666666.
- ONE accent colour: electric indigo #314DD0 — only for "AI moments" (the star, scan line, check marks, match lines, gauge fill, CTA pill). Use it sparingly.
- Typeface: "Helvetica Neue", fallback Inter Tight / Inter. Bold for slams, Medium for UI. letter-spacing -0.04em, tight leading. Numbers inside UI in a mono (JetBrains Mono / DM Mono) with odometer roll-ups.
- Red #FF3B30 allowed ONLY in the chaos act for "UNMATCHED" tags, and it must be gone once the AI appears.

BEAT SHEET (exact timings)
0.0–0.5s HOOK: black; a single blinking spreadsheet cell + cursor, small grey mono text "31 March. 11:58 PM." Sub-bass hit.
0.5–2.4s CHAOS: dozens of bank-statement rows, invoices and GST receipts fly at camera from deep z-space (parallax, 40+ cards), red "UNMATCHED" tags multiplying, a mono row-counter racing 0 → 48,213, camera shake growing. Huge white Bold words slam one per beat, centred over the chaos: "Bank statements." / "Invoices." / "Ledgers." / "Reconciliation."
2.4–3.6s QUESTION: everything freezes mid-air, desaturates, then collapses/implodes to a single centre point. Giant white text slams in word-by-word: "Still doing this by hand?"
3.6–4.0s: pure black, riser sucks in.
4.0–6.2s REVEAL (the drop): a single four-point star ignites dead centre in #314DD0 with lens bloom + light rays, then the two white halves of the A-Star slide in from left and right and lock around it, white flash frame on impact, logo settles with a gentle scale-down. Beneath it fades up "Meet your new AI Accountant." (Medium weight).
6.2–9.0s FEATURE 1: logo flies to top-left corner (small). A sleek dark glass dashboard slams in with a 3D tilt. 10–12 raw bank rows in mono, e.g. "UPI/SWIGGY/948213  ₹1,240", "NEFT/AMZN SELLER/2231  ₹18,400", "IMPS/RAZORPAY/77812  ₹52,000", "ACH/AWS INDIA/0091  ₹9,870". An indigo scan line sweeps top→bottom and each row gets a category chip snapped on with an indigo tick ("Staff welfare", "Office supplies", "Payment gateway", "Cloud & software"…). Big headline beside it: "Categorised." then "In seconds."
9.0–11.6s FEATURE 2: whip-pan right. Two columns "Bank" and "Books". Indigo bezier lines draw between matching rows in a fast cascade; any red UNMATCHED tags flip to white "MATCHED". A ring gauge fills 0% → 100% in indigo. Headline: "Reconciled."
11.6–13.4s FEATURE 3: matched entries compress into a glowing indigo packet that shoots into a ledger/book icon; journal entries print line by line (Dr/Cr). Headline: "Posted to your books."
13.4–16.4s PROOF: hard cut to a 2×2 stat grid, each tile slams in on a beat with numbers rolling up: "300M+" transactions analysed · "75%" of manual accounting tasks handled · "20K+" vendors categorised · "ISO" certified.
16.4–17.4s THE LINE: clean wipe; type on "Accounting done for you in hours" — "hours" gets struck through and kicked out, replaced by "minutes." in indigo.
17.4–20.0s END CARD: A-Star logo centred with "AI Accountant" wordmark beneath (keep clearspace = star width), the star glints once. Below: "aiaccountant.com" and an indigo pill button "Talk to us" with a soft pulse. Tiny grey line: "India's first AI accountant". Hold clean so it loops.
